summary: Iteration 13 — GRC Onboarding wizard refactor. Backend pytest 12/12 passing against the preview backend. Verified: (a) GET /api/onboarding/requirements-library shape — 5 categories with correct counts (Assurance 4, Legal 4, Contractual 5, Insurance 1, Other 2), role_templates length=10, assessment_types length=13; (b) POST /api/onboarding/finalize idempotence — second submit yields policies_created=0/requirements_created=0/assessments_created=0/reviews_created=0 while policies_updated>=1 and requirements_updated>=1; DB confirmed exactly one row per (client_id + title) for policies/requirements; (c) N/A applicability without rationale returns validation_errors[] (does not crash) for BOTH policy N/A (no applicability_rationale) and requirement N/A (no rationale); (d) contacts (with and without linked_user_id) do NOT create user accounts — /api/users count identical before/after; (e) Known Issue classification=verified_finding creates a Finding with source='GRC Program Onboarding · Existing Finding' and severity mirrors priority; classification=reported creates a Task with source='GRC Program Onboarding · Known Issue' and priority preserved; (f) Requirements Register generic CRUD via KIND_REGEX — POST creates req_* id, PATCH updates applicability, GET reflects the change; (g) RBAC — GET /api/onboarding/state as acme_contributor for Globex client_id => 403; as readonly@acme.demo for Acme => 200 with contacts/assessments/onboarding_history payload; POST /finalize as readonly => 403; (h) audit_logs onboarding_history contains onboarding-response, onboarding-contact, onboarding-assessment, onboarding-known-issue, onboarding-review, and onboarding-complete events; (i) weekly digest regression POST /api/reminders/send-weekly-now still returns ok=true. Frontend Playwright verified on /onboarding as platform.admin@grc.demo: stepper displays EXACTLY 6 steps in order (POLICIES & GOVERNANCE DOCUMENTS → REQUIREMENTS & OBLIGATIONS → KEY ROLES & CONTACTS → EXISTING ASSESSMENTS / KNOWN ISSUES → RECURRING REVIEWS → REVIEW & CREATE) with no standalone 'Risks' step; the Summary step (data-testid=onboarding-step-summary) renders all required sections: summary-policies, summary-requirements, summary-contacts, summary-assessments, summary-reviews, and summary-records-created; per-contact and per-review row testids also present (summary-contact-*, summary-review-*). Regression: /clients, /policies, /action-items, /dashboard, /vendors, /risks all return 200. Frontend does not POST /baseline anywhere — only /baseline/templates GET remains (used to prefill recurring-review defaults).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4047 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. The onboarding orchestrator (lines 3200-3634, ~430 lines) is a great extraction candidate to /app/backend/routes/onboarding.py.

Onboarding.jsx is 847 lines — right at the guideline. Consider splitting per-step components (StepPolicies, StepRequirements, StepContacts, StepAssessments, StepReviews, StepSummary) into /components/onboarding/ for readability.

onboarding/finalize `contacts_saved` counter increments on every upsert (create OR update), which makes the idempotence contract for contacts different from policies/requirements (which split created vs updated). Consider adding contacts_created / contacts_updated separately so the summary 'Records to be Created or Updated' section can distinguish.

Known Issue promotion dedups by (client_id + title + source-scope). If a user changes the classification of a known issue between two finalize runs (reported→verified_finding), the first submission's Task remains open AND a new Finding is created — resulting in two rows for the same underlying issue. Consider a cross-source dedup or a note in the finalize response.
onboarding/state pulls audit history with `.to_list(200)` — fine for now, but on a mature tenant a time-window ($gt: last 12 months) would keep the payload snappy.

N/A validation returns 200 with validation_errors[] rather than 400. This is aligned with the 'never lose partial progress' intent, but the frontend should surface these strings prominently — currently the counter modal shows records-created but the errors array is only logged. Recommend adding a visible error banner on the Summary step when validation_errors.length > 0.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 6 stepper labels + all 6 required summary sections render as spec'd
